about_the_game:
A missing dog. A sinister town. A day that never ends.

13-year-old Diya thought moving to the sleepy town of Lakeview would be the worst thing to happen to her. She was wrong.

When her beloved dog Beans vanishes without a trace, Diya finds herself trapped in a nightmarish time loop, reliving the same day over and over – the day before Diwali. But each reset reveals darker truths lurking beneath Lakeview’s quiet façade, and Diya begins to realise the town itself is far more dangerous than she ever imagined.

Groundhog Day meets Stranger Things in this narrative-driven, point-and-click supernatural thriller that brings a dark twist to an ordinary teen's life. Navigate a town where neighbours are hiding dark secrets and each repeated day brings you closer to startling revelations.

With her frustrating day stuck on repeat, ending with the same tired question from her parents — "How was your day?" — Diya realises that if she has any chance of solving the mystery, she must break out of her comfort zone, confront her fears, use her knowledge of video games, and...ugh, talk to her parents! As she starts to open up and seek answers, Diya discovers that the residents of Lakeview are hiding secrets while a sinister presence shadows her every move. As pets around town begin disappearing and a strange aurora lights the sky, growing deeper and more ominous with each loop, Diya must question everything and everyone — while the mystery of Beans’s disappearance looms larger with each loop.

Who, or what, is behind the time loop and Beans’ mysterious disappearance? And how does the festival of Diwali tie into the unfolding mystery?

  • Supernatural Time Loop Mystery: Experience a teen's everyday life turned upside down with a sinister twist.

  • Uncover Dark Secrets: Question townspeople, uncover secrets, investigate disappearances and suspicious activity, while piecing together the supernatural mystery plaguing Lakeview.

  • Immersive Narrative: A coming-of-age story about family, friendship, and finding light in the face of darkness.

  • Atmospheric Environments: Explore unique and beautifully illustrated authentic locations that grow more ominous with each time loop.

  • 80s Nostalgia: Set in the late 80s, Diya’s world features video games, 80s fashion, a retro soundtrack, and pop culture references that bring the era to life.

  • Diverse Cast & Setting: Set in the fictional small town of Lakeview, based in Aotearoa, New Zealand, How Was Your Day? features relatable characters and themes of diversity, drawing on Indian, Pacific, and New Zealand culture.

  • 80s-Inspired Mini Games: Progress through challenges and puzzles playing mini-games inspired by 80s classics like Pong, Frogger, Space Invaders, Pacman, and more!

  • 80s Collectables & Discoveries: Discover and collect retro Dumpster Darling trading cards, classic 80s cassette tapes and spot native birds as you explore every corner of Lakeview.

  • Unique New Zealand Setting: Explore a lovingly crafted and beautifully illustrated 80s small town and experience a rare glimpse into 1980s New Zealand. Featuring authentic Kiwi culture, iconic local shops, native birds, and the charming natural beauty that capture the essence of Aotearoa, New Zealand.

short_description: After her beloved dog Beans vanishes and 13-year-old Diya finds herself trapped in a nightmarish time loop, each day reveals darker secrets in the sleepy town of Lakeview. Nothing, and no one, is what it seems. Groundhog Day meets Stranger Things in this supernatural thriller set in 80s New Zealand.
